notes.title: BRAND SPANKIN' NEW UPDATE!
notes.content:
Welcome to the first major HyperFleet update! Here's what has been added!

[h3]CloutCoin/Hangar:[/h3]
A (fictional) cryptocurrency you can buy/earn to get cool new ships!

[h3]Time Trials/Ghost Replays[/h3]
Race against yourself or other players via LIVE ghost replays!

[h3]Practice mode:[/h3]
Practice the levels without the threat of crashing!

[h3]Flight School:[/h3]
Learn the basics of the game with Snoob Goob!

[h3]Discord:[/h3]
HyperFleet now has a dedicated Discord server: https://discord.gg/5wZ9Nf3NZg

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
-Ultra-wide monitor support (21:9)
-Level collider optimization
-Offline functionality

As a thank you for the support, anyone who owned the game prior to this update got 1000 Clout Coins added to their account. Enjoy ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: HyperFleet - Update 1.1
notes.content:
Hey there pilots!

Update 1.1.1 is now available for HyperFleet

[b]Update Notes[/b]

General Fixes
[list]
[*] Removed twist input delay
[*] Moved mouse sensitivity slider so it isn't accidentally selected after restarting a level
[/list]


[b]Coming Soon[/b]
[list]
[*] Flight School: Replacing the "How to Play" sections with a set of tutorial levels hosted by Snoob Goob to learn the basics hands-on
[*] Monkey mode ;)

[/list]

Thank you for your support!
